name: dca-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins for Domain-Centric Architecture (DCA) and general software craftsmanship — composable skills and reviewer agents for daily practice.

plugins.name: dca-core
plugins.description: The Domain-Centric Architecture method as skills, for Java/Spring and .NET/C#: dca-describe writes the project description (product, technical decisions, designed domain) under project/; dca-new starts a project from a generator and lays out contexts, use cases, aggregates, stores and domain services; dca-init adds the published dca-building-blocks/dca-archunit or DomainCentric.BuildingBlocks/ArchRules packages, one architecture test and the method's section in AGENTS.md; dca-add brings in one capability (rule module, freeze, formatter, browser runner); dca-modelling carries the tactical-modelling craft, dca-discipline the invariants, dca-review the DCA conformance review, dca-knowledge the cited knowledge catalog. Pairs with dca-craft.

plugins.name: dca-craft
plugins.description: Craft skills and agents independent of the architecture style: Test-Driven Development, Clean Code while writing, Architecture Decision Records, end-user browser tests (Page Objects, stable selectors, setting up a browser runner), the Ubiquitous Language glossary and the strategic context map, and three review perspectives with the familiar names — review-ddd, review-hexagonal, review-clean-code — plus thin reviewer and E2E agents around them. An outside view: it reads what any project has — code, glossary, context map, AGENTS.md — and names no DCA artifact. Pairs with dca-core, which adds the DCA method.

plugins.name: dca-factory
plugins.description: Delivery pipeline for DCA projects, in three parts: a project description under project/ (product, technical decisions, designed domain — written through the method's description skill), a markdown backlog contract (epics with intent, goal, outcome-event metric and domain contact; stories with keyed acceptance criteria), and a runner — the stage skills plan/test/build/tidy/judge/document with one hand-over file each and a dependency-free story gate between them that checks epic completeness, one red-then-green end-user test per criterion, the architecture suite and the documentation claims. factory-setup sets it up idempotently (stack detection from presets, carrier lines only for installed skills), factory-backlog writes the backlog, factory-decisions answers what a run may not decide itself, factory-status and factory-verify look at it. Portable by construction: plain skill folders and one dependency-free script, with no harness-specific tool in the contract. Carries no architecture method and no project knowledge — those stay in dca-core and in the project's stack profile.
